Using the network of producers and consumers built there, the company also handles furusato nōzei, planned travel for children, an accommodation booking site, and entrusted projects for local governments. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the figures are those of the company on a non-consolidated basis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,027,929 thousand (up 0.6% year on year).

entries.8f21c175ca1d265d: "Pocket Marche" is an app on which producers can list items, including non-standard goods, from 1 item at prices they set freely, with all work completed on a smartphone. Producers and consumers can exchange messages 1-to-1, and as of the end of December 2025, about 9,000 producers were registered and about 14,000 items were listed. The securities report states that producers and consumers connect directly as individuals, which differs from conventional distribution through intermediaries and also helps keep the company's operating costs down. Building on this platform, the company also runs support for local governments, "Pocket Marche Oyako Chiho Ryugaku", "STAY JAPAN" and other services.

It offers members living in rural areas, acquired through registered producers of "Pocket Marche" and their connections, and members living in cities, acquired through Web media, opportunities to be matched with about 90,000 marriage-seeking members held by IBJ, a matchmaking agency federation, and earns revenue from marriage counseling, arranging of meetings, relationship management and other services. The securities report does not state this segment's sales on its own.

entries.9b1ffad62cdf4d13: Operation of the direct-from-producer app "Pocket Marche", a subscription service that delivers food regularly, the platform for "Taberu Tsushin", an information magazine bundled with food, and the hometown tax donation platform "Pokemaru Furusato Nozei". "Pocket Marche" is a service where people buy food while communicating directly with farmers and fishers across Japan; it has been offered since September 2016 and earns revenue from sales commissions on transactions. As of the end of December 2025, about 9,000 producers are registered and about 14,000 items are listed. "Taberu Tsushin" is published in 15 regions across Japan and earns commission fees from the publishers that belong to the "Japan Taberu Tsushin League". "Pokemaru Furusato Nozei" is a mechanism in which items produced within the area of a contracted municipality automatically become return gifts, and it earns revenue from fees from municipalities and sales commissions from producers. The securities report also mentions the streamlining of low-profitability in-house developed products.

entries.9d4da9be1016c486: A reportable segment grouping the services provided to individual consumers, including the direct-from-producer food app "Pocket Marche" where food can be bought directly from producers, hometown tax donations, planned travel for children, an accommodation booking site and a matchmaking service. Of the two reportable segments, it is the one with the larger sales to external customers. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales were ¥726,237 thousand (down 3.7% from the previous year) and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥170,876 thousand (operating profit of ¥73,591 thousand in the previous year). The securities report says that, amid rising prices, selling, general and administrative expenses were reduced through more efficient operations, and the profitability of the food business improved greatly from the previous year. From the current fiscal year, the former single segment "Related Population Creation Business" was changed into two segments, Consumer Services and Corporate Services, and the previous year's figures have been restated under the new classification.
entries.a286dfebe3d27d82: Operation of "Pokemaru Oyako Chiho Ryugaku", a planned trip for children, and "STAY JAPAN", an accommodation booking site. "Pokemaru Oyako Chiho Ryugaku" is a program in which parents and children visit a production area, the parents work remotely while the children experience nature with producers, and it earns revenue from participants. In summer 2025 it was held in 7 regions across Japan, with 186 families and 475 people taking part, compared with 143 families in the previous year. "STAY JAPAN" is a site listing about 1,000 accommodations such as private lodgings, farm stays and traditional old-house stays, and the business was acquired from Hyakusen Renma Co., Ltd. in April 2025. It arranges for the accommodations to provide services to guests and earns commission income.
